description: Mentionlytics lets marketing, PR, and social media teams explore and analyze social media listening data, previously unavailable on ChatGPT. Uncover the people, channels, and sources driving discussion across social media, web, reviews, and other monitored media. Allow ChatGPT to deeply analyze your brand and your competitors mentions on Social Media to discover patterns and meaningful conclusions.
